en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to prepare students in theoretical and practical terms for passing the industrial certification exam CCNP Enterprise mplementing Cisco Enterprise Advanced Routing and Services (300-410 ENARSI).
